purpose: Review a finite issuer committed-credit-facility, covenant, borrowing-base, collateral-availability, lender-consent and refinancing-backstop lifecycle domain before opening source rows, agreements, filing values, factor values, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.credit_event_boundary: Campaign156 freezes rating downgrade, bankruptcy or restructuring acceptance, bond default or delayed payment and related governance-event source admission. A covenant test, waiver or undrawn committed facility is a contractual liquidity state before or alongside a public credit event, not a relabelled default event.
repository_evidence.debt_maturity_boundary: Campaign161 freezes accounting debt-maturity resilience. Debt due dates do not identify a committed facility, remaining availability, lender conditions, financial covenant threshold and headroom, borrowing base, collateral margin, waiver or refinancing commitment.
repository_evidence.supply_chain_boundary: Campaign163 freezes customer, supplier, order and procurement disclosure. Supplier finance may interact with liquidity, but a commercial counterparty relationship does not establish a lender commitment, credit agreement, covenant or borrowing-base state.
repository_evidence.insurance_boundary: Campaign172 freezes insurance coverage, claims and recovery. A policy or surety may support obligations, but it does not prove facility availability, covenant compliance, lender consent, collateral borrowing base or refinancing commitment.
repository_evidence.lease_boundary: Campaign175 freezes lease commitments and right-of-use state. Lease liabilities can enter covenant definitions, but a lease schedule does not identify the full credit agreement, covenant calculation, threshold, waiver or undrawn liquidity backstop.
repository_evidence.guarantee_boundary: The terminal CNInfo guarantee branch cannot be reopened by renaming a guarantee or guarantee count as credit support. Borrower, facility, lender, covenant and availability identity must be independently sourced.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current credit limit, latest covenant ratio or balance-sheet note cannot be projected backward without agreement execution, effective, draw, repayment, commitment change, test date, breach, waiver, cure, amendment, renewal, cancellation, refinancing and first-public histories.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: exact executed credit agreement, amendment, waiver, lender or agent confirmation, exchange filing or licensed structured source with immutable bytes and stable agreement, facility, borrower, lender, document and observation identifiers

execution, effective, first-public, draw, repayment, commitment increase or reduction, test, breach, notice, waiver, cure, amendment, extension, refinancing, cancellation, termination, correction and supersession timestamps with trading-session availability

issuer, listed security, parent, borrower, co-borrower, guarantor, restricted subsidiary, unrestricted subsidiary, lender, syndicate, administrative agent, collateral agent and beneficial controller mapping without current-state leakage

facility taxonomy separating committed revolver, uncommitted line, term loan, bridge, delayed-draw term loan, overdraft, letter-of-credit line, commercial-paper backstop, receivables facility, securitization, supply-chain finance and bilateral or syndicated arrangement

total commitment, drawn principal, letters of credit, swingline, reserved amount, available amount, currency, tranche, borrowing window, maturity, amortization, commitment fee, interest margin and utilization semantics

maintenance and incurrence covenant taxonomy, exact numerator and denominator definitions, accounting adjustments, threshold, test frequency, headroom, equity cure, holiday, springing trigger, basket and permitted-action semantics
borrowing-base collateral pool, eligibility, advance rate, concentration limit, reserve, appraisal, haircut, margin, collateral value, redetermination, deficiency, margin call and cure semantics

conditions precedent and subsequent, representation, material-adverse-change, default, cross-default, change-of-control, sanctions, availability blocker, draw request, lender discretion and funding refusal semantics
breach, potential default, event of default, notice, grace period, waiver, forbearance, consent, amendment, acceleration, foreclosure, cancellation and reinstatement identity

refinancing commitment, mandate, underwriting, bridge-to-bond or bridge-to-equity, syndication, market flex, lender hold, conditions, expiration, extension, takeout and failed or withdrawn financing semantics

consolidated scope, restricted group, gross and net presentation, currency and unit, accounting-versus-contract definition, restatement and missing, undisclosed, unavailable, uncommitted, zero draw, zero headroom, no breach, expired and cancelled semantics

complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest, full-market denominator, issuer, borrower, facility, agreement, lender and collateral identifier history, delisting and merger coverage, pagination and parser, identity, timing, scope, amount, covenant, availability and source-acceptance tests using no factor, comparator, security-price or return values

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: committed_revolving_credit_and_liquidity_backstop_availability_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer committed-credit state linking facility commitment, draw, letter-of-credit use, reserved amount, remaining availability, borrowing conditions, fee, maturity, renewal, reduction, cancellation and termination.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted point-in-time history freezes agreement and tranche identity, borrower and listed-security mapping, committed versus uncommitted status, draw and repayment, letters of credit and reserves, borrowing conditions, availability, fees, maturity, amendment, renewal, cancellation, corrections and first-public timing across 2019-2023.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: financial_covenant_test_headroom_breach_waiver_and_cure_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer covenant state covering exact contractual ratio definition, threshold, test date, headroom, springing or incurrence trigger, breach, grace, waiver, equity cure, amendment and restoration.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository lacks a complete agreement-level history preserving contract-specific numerator and denominator adjustments, test perimeter and frequency, threshold and baskets, breach and notice date, waiver and cure conditions, lender consent, amendment, reinstatement, correction and trading-session availability.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: borrowing_base_collateral_margin_and_draw_availability_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer asset-backed availability state linking eligible collateral, advance rate, reserve, concentration limit, appraisal, borrowing base, outstanding exposure, deficiency, margin call, cure and restored draw capacity.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted source connects facility and collateral pool identity, eligibility and advance rules, valuations and reserves, outstanding use, redetermination, deficiency and margin calls, cure, amendments, releases, corrections and complete public timing without current-collateral leakage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: lender_consent_refinancing_commitment_extension_and_takeout_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer financing-certainty state covering lender consent, committed refinancing or bridge, underwriting, syndication, conditions, market flex, expiration, extension, takeout, withdrawal and replacement.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No complete point-in-time source preserves mandate versus binding commitment, lenders and facility identity, conditions and flex, amount and term, syndication and funding status, expiration, extension, takeout, failure or withdrawal, replacement, correction and first-public history.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: cash_leverage_debt_maturity_rating_default_guarantee_lease_contract_or_security_price_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: An existing cash, accounting leverage, debt maturity, credit rating or default, guarantee, lease, commercial contract or security-price state relabelled as facility availability or covenant headroom.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Cash, leverage, maturity, rating, default, guarantee, lease, customer contract or price does not identify the executed credit agreement, commitment, draw blockers, exact covenant definition, threshold, borrowing base, waiver, lender consent or refinancing commitment.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: facility_covenant_availability_direction_threshold_denominator_term_window_or_subset_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A direction, transform or subset of committed amount, available amount, utilization, covenant headroom, threshold, collateral coverage, waiver, lender consent, maturity, sector, peer or event window.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing more or less utilization, large or small headroom, accounting versus contract denominator, short or long term, secured versus unsecured subset, successful waivers only, sector, lag or event window before source admission would multiply hypotheses and introduce survivorship.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_facility_availability_covenant_borrowing_base_and_refinancing_score_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A joint issuer liquidity-backstop score across committed availability, covenant compliance and waivers, collateral borrowing base and lender-consented refinancing commitments.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining four unadmitted heterogeneous source families or choosing normalization, ranks, weights, interactions, filters, subsets or models would expand the search before any base source contract is complete.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Four distinct facility, covenant, borrowing-base and refinancing-backstop lifecycle states remain deferred at source admission; accounting, debt, event, guarantee, lease, contract or price relabeling, premature operator search and unadmitted combinations are closed before values.

next_action: Record all seven scientific decisions in the Campaign182 hash chain, publish terminal accounting, and continue a different finite offline prevalue domain.
